scope: Weighted ordered matching on supplied small compatibility graphs; no image experiment
same_template_row_updates: query all edges before updating any Fenwick state

cyclic_cases.open_open: fixed template order; both scene directions
cyclic_cases.closed_open: all compatible template cuts; both scene directions
cyclic_cases.open_closed: all compatible scene cuts; both scene directions
cyclic_cases.closed_closed: fixed canonical template cut zero; all compatible scene cuts; both scene directions

witness_tie_order: lexicographically smallest reversed sequence of original edge IDs
limitations: A synthetic core pass does not demonstrate pixel provenance, end-to-end correctness, accuracy or speed
Full pixel inputs, chain extraction and execution budgets still require their own source and input freeze
No parameter may be selected from new development scores
